content:
zoe: Need a short-lived SIEM export (30m) for vuln triage — contains user auth logs + request traces. Need KMS unwrap and analyst access. Who can approve?

matt: what's the specific dataset? can we scrub PII first?

zoe: auth-events, token-exchange logs, and proxy headers. We can run a scrubbed view but vuln team needs raw fields for correlation (trace_id, user_agent, ip).

nina: kube/proxy logs include IPs and pod metadata — we should mask before export where possible. If this is for active exploit triage, follow the incident export template and include justification + ticket link.

zoe: filed INC-8421 in jira, attached logs sample. urgency: active exploit observed. proposing ttl = 1 hour. will attach justification in the ticket.

alina: legal: confirm there is no customer PII (email, full user identifiers). if present, we need DPA signoff. otherwise legal ok for limited, timeboxed access and audit trail.

matt: ops note: KMS unwrap policy => ephemeral unwrap for <=1h can be approved by one security approver + oncall. >1h or exports containing PII require two approvers and legal ok. Tag export: ephemeral-export:incident.

devops-bot: Required action: run `/request_unwrap --key projects/redwood/keys/siem-export --ttl 3600 --ticket INC-8421` to generate KMS request. Approval needed before unwrap.

sam: i'm available to approve now. @matt can you run the scrub pipeline and request the unwrap? i'll ack in the ticket once i see the request id.

matt: will run scrub first. plan: remove direct usernames & mask IPs, keep trace_id and timestamps. running scrub command now:
```
python tools/scrub_logs.py \
  --input="siem://auth-events?since=2024-06-15T12:30Z" \
  --remove=full_name,email --mask=ip --retain=trace_id,user_agent \
  --out=gs://tmp-triage/5990012345
```

zoe: please include the KMS unwrap id in INC-8421 and add an auditor for chain-of-custody. @jade can you shadow the access?

jade: will join and add myself to the access log. i'll monitor queries and take screenshots of the export job metadata.

oncall-bot: oncall = alex (pager duty). alex, please acknowledge the one-hour window and approve as second approver if required.

alex: acked. i'll be on call and will approve the ephemeral unwrap. (time window checked)

matt: scrub completed. initiating KMS unwrap request: `/request_unwrap --key projects/redwood/keys/siem-export --ttl 3600 --ticket INC-8421` => kms-req-5990012345. Sending to approvers.

devops-bot: KMS unwrap request kms-req-5990012345 created. Waiting for approvals from sam and alex.

sam: approved kms-req-5990012345 in INC-8421.

alex: approved kms-req-5990012345.

matt: unwrap completed, grant ephemeral role `siem_viewer:expires=2024-06-15T15:02Z` to group [vuln-triage]. Export placed at `gs://tmp-triage/5990012345`. Cleanup job scheduled in 60m.

nina: reminder: do not copy logs to personal drives or slack. access is read-only and auditable. cleanup job will delete bucket objects and revoke role.

alina: legal confirms DPA not required (no customer PII in scrubbed export). Logged confirmation in INC-8421.

zoe: triage done. found correlation that pointed to compromised service account, mitigation steps executed. no PII surfaced. closing loop, initiating cleanup. thanks everyone :tada:

sam: adding postmortem notes and SIEM rule tuning in follow-up. will create a short runbook for future one-hour triage exports.

jade: verified cleanup completed and auditor screenshots attached to INC-8421.

devops-bot: cleanup complete for `gs://tmp-triage/5990012345`. KMS request kms-req-5990012345 archived.

zoe: export window closed. marking ticket as resolved. great job team. :thumbsup:
